selected_evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL primary configured on node1 with replication-enabled settings and replication role
selected_evidence.summary: initdb on node1, postgresql.conf/pg_hba.conf updated for wal_level=replica and scram-sha-256 replication access, postgresql started, replicator role created with REPLICATION LOGIN

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 provisioned as read-only standbys via pg_basebackup from node1
selected_evidence.summary: pg_basebackup -R completed 100% on both nodes creating standby.signal and primary_conninfo pointing at node1; postgresql started successfully on both

selected_evidence.requirement: Standbys are in streaming replication and read-only
selected_evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both node2 and node3 in 'streaming' state; pg_is_in_recovery() returns true on both standbys

selected_evidence.requirement: Changes committed on the primary are visible on both standbys
selected_evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 is immediately visible via SELECT on node2 and node3; direct INSERT attempts on both standbys fail with 'cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction'

selected_evidence.requirement: Credentials generated on managed nodes, not exposed as literals in tool commands
selected_evidence.summary: Replication password generated on node1 via /dev/urandom, used only through shell variable indirection in commands, and relayed to node2/node3 over a temporary socat TCP listener on the private cluster network rather than embedding the literal secret in any tool call; relay torn down afterward

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline capture, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a50ee593... with healthy replication/data captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 2f804993... (changed) confirmed reachable; postgresql auto-started, repl_test data intact, both standbys reconnected streaming

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline capture, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a03569af... with pg_is_in_recovery=true and data present captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 599f9606... (changed) confirmed reachable; postgresql auto-started in recovery mode with data intact; node1 pg_stat_replication shows node2 reconnected streaming

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline capture, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8b1bd118... with pg_is_in_recovery=true and data present captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 61a998bd... (changed) confirmed reachable; postgresql auto-started in recovery mode with data intact; node1 pg_stat_replication shows both standbys streaming again

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart end-to-end replication proof across all three restarted nodes
selected_evidence.summary: A row inserted on node1 after all three restarts appears identically on both node2 and node3, confirming replication remained fully functional through the entire restart sequence
